task: Pretrained Flood Segmentation Model Shortlist and Feasibility Evaluation

candidates.name: KuroSiwo SNUNet-CD with ECAM
candidates.organization: Orion Lab / National Observatory of Athens
candidates.paper: Kuro Siwo: 33 billion m^2 under the water (NeurIPS 2024)
strengths: Trained directly on Kuro Siwo benchmark (our target training dataset specified in DECISIONS.md)
SAR-native Sentinel-1 GRD, exactly matching our ingestion pipeline
Siamese multi-temporal architecture fits pre/post event analysis
Extremely lightweight (3.2M params), runs in <200MB RAM, easily fits 2GB container
Clean PyTorch convolutions and attention, seamlessly exports to ONNX opset 17
gaps_and_adaptation: Pretrained head has 2 classes instead of 3 (needs new 3-class 1x1 conv output layer)
Input branches expect 2 channels each (VV, VH) instead of 9 channels (adapter stacks pre1/pre2 and routes terrain features)
Requires short fine-tuning (10-20 epochs) to adapt output head to 3 classes and terrain integration

candidates.name: SMP U-Net with ResNet-34 Encoder (HydroViz Planned Architecture)
candidates.weights_url: ImageNet pretrained encoder weights (auto-download via torchvision/timm)
strengths: Exact 9-channel input and 3-class output supported out of the box with zero adapter layers
Directly documented in training/README.md and ARCHITECTURE.md as primary plan
Mature, stable PyTorch and ONNX export ecosystem
gaps_and_adaptation: No SAR flood-specific pretraining (starts from ImageNet optical weights)
Requires full training from scratch on Kuro Siwo dataset rather than rapid fine-tuning
8x higher parameter count than SNUNet (24.4M vs 3.2M)

candidates.name: NASA ETCI-2021 Semi-Supervised U-Net
candidates.weights_url: Available in repository release / Google Drive
strengths: SAR-native pretraining on real Sentinel-1 flood disasters
gaps_and_adaptation: Single-temporal architecture lacks pre-flood baseline integration
Binary output ignores permanent water bodies
License is not clearly specified in the repository

candidates.name: Attentive U-Net for Sentinel-1 Flood Detection
candidates.organization: Yadav et al., Frontiers in Remote Sensing (2022)
candidates.paper: Uni-Temporal Flood Detection Using Sentinel-1 SAR (Frontiers 2022)
strengths: Attention gates improve boundary delineation for shallow floods
gaps_and_adaptation: Uni-temporal only, lacks multi-temporal change detection
Cannot distinguish permanent water from flood without post-processing mask

candidates.name: KuroSiwo FloodViT
candidates.organization: Orion Lab / National Observatory of Athens
candidates.paper: Kuro Siwo: 33 billion m^2 under the water (NeurIPS 2024)
strengths: State of the art global attention on Kuro Siwo benchmark
gaps_and_adaptation: Massive checkpoint (784 MB) and heavy memory footprint (~1.8GB RAM during inference)
Risk of Out-Of-Memory (OOM) inside strict 2GB Docker container
Vision Transformer ONNX export with dynamic windowing is fragile and slow on CPU

candidates.name: STURM-Flood U-Net (Sentinel-1)
strengths: Well documented on Zenodo with published weights
gaps_and_adaptation: Built in TensorFlow/Keras while HydroViz stack is PyTorch/ONNX
Tile dimension mismatch (128x128 vs HydroViz 256x256)
CC BY-SA 4.0 share-alike license imposes viral licensing on downstream software

candidates.name: IBM-NASA Prithvi-EO 1.0 (100M) Sen1Floods11
candidates.paper: Foundation Models for Generalist Geospatial AI (2024)
strengths: Pretrained foundation model backed by NASA and IBM
gaps_and_adaptation: CRITICAL SENSOR MISMATCH: Requires 6 optical bands from HLS/Sentinel-2; cannot ingest Sentinel-1 SAR
Sen1Floods11 dataset has both optical and SAR subsets, but Prithvi was trained exclusively on the optical subset
Heavy ViT foundation model requires 4GB+ RAM, completely unusable inside a 2GB container

candidates.name: IBM-NASA Prithvi-EO 2.0 (300M-TL) Sen1Floods11
gaps_and_adaptation: Optical only: fundamentally incompatible with HydroViz SAR pipeline
Exceeds even total host RAM limit (8 GB)
